reason: Both conversations correctly told the homeowner to stop using the machine and not keep resetting the trip, but Conversation 2 ended there with no questions, no diagnosis and no guidance on who to call. Conversation 1 asked a sensible timing question, correctly read the 'only on 40/60 washes' pattern as likely heater element earth leakage while leaving pump/wiring open, and rightly steered him to an appliance engineer rather than an electrician. Conversation 1 has flaws - a stray burning-smell warning that didn't match his report, a continuity test suggestion he couldn't perform, and it never asked which device trips or for the full model number - but it still served the homeowner far better than Conversation 2's bare safety notice.
